# New patent monetization data shows increased opportunities for law firm-funder collaboration


- Patent & IP


July 10, 2025


**Katharine Wolanyk & Christopher Freeman**


## Summary


Patent monetization, including direct enforcement (litigation), divestitures and licensing arrangements, is becoming increasingly common among companies with significant patent portfolios.
